episode.title: Restore persisted conversation state when starting a new session
episode.before: At parent 1098b428e6e118be2e4ebb49a3dd2b14ae79e50e, the application appended conversations to a Markdown history file, but Coder initialization always began with an empty done_messages list unless messages were explicitly supplied by a caller. The persisted history was therefore not reloaded on launch. ChatSummary always used the model's fixed history-token setting, and summarization sent the entire selected head to the weak model without first constraining it to that model's input context.
episode.after: At merge commit 45b2ba8a1056bb27f197b01d08f3ea0d4d92b668, startup can read the configured Markdown history file when no completed-message state was supplied, reconstruct user and assistant messages while excluding session headings, tool output, commands, and blank prompts, and start background compaction when the restored state exceeds its token budget. The budget may be overridden through a command-line option and otherwise inherits the model setting. Head summarization is additionally limited to the most recent messages that fit within the summarizer model's input context, and startup announcements report successful restoration.
episode.diff: Relative to first parent 1098b428e6e118be2e4ebb49a3dd2b14ae79e50e, the implementation changes four files with 68 insertions and 29 deletions: it extracts Markdown-to-message reconstruction into ChatSummary; loads and conditionally compacts persisted history during Coder initialization; adds and propagates a maximum-history-token override; reports restored state in announcements; and bounds the input selected for a summarization request. No automated test file was changed or added.

evidence_units.claim: Pinned ref 45b2ba8a1056bb27f197b01d08f3ea0d4d92b668 is a merge commit for pull request 591, titled "Restore prior chat history on launch", with first parent 1098b428e6e118be2e4ebb49a3dd2b14ae79e50e.
evidence_units.source: git show --format=fuller --stat 45b2ba8a1056bb27f197b01d08f3ea0d4d92b668; issue-bundle.json resolved_commit and parent_commit

evidence_units.claim: The first-parent implementation diff changes aider/args.py, aider/coders/base_coder.py, aider/history.py, and aider/main.py with 68 insertions and 29 deletions.

Before the change, Coder initialized done_messages from an explicit argument or an empty list and created ChatSummary from the model's fixed max_chat_history_tokens; it did not read persisted chat history during initialization.

The new Markdown reconstruction operation skips session headings, blockquoted tool/status output, slash-command prompts, and blank prompts; it emits user messages from remaining level-four headings and assistant messages from intervening text.

When no completed messages were supplied, Coder initialization reads io.chat_history_file, reconstructs persisted messages when text exists, assigns them to done_messages, and invokes summarize_start.
The history file consumed at startup is the same configured file to which InputOutput appends session headings, user prompts, assistant output, and blockquoted tool output.
evidence_units.source: git show 45b2ba8a1056bb27f197b01d08f3ea0d4d92b668:aider/io.py, constructor around lines 95-142 and append_chat_history around lines 351-362

evidence_units.claim: The restoration path preserves explicitly supplied completed-message state because it reads the persisted file only when done_messages is empty.
summarize_start is a conditional compaction gate: it returns when restored messages fit the budget, otherwise starts a background worker whose result later replaces done_messages.

Before calling the summarizer, the changed algorithm walks backward through the selected head and retains only the newest messages fitting within the summarizer model's max_input_tokens minus a 512-token reserve.
A new --max-chat-history-tokens integer option defaults to None, is passed by main into Coder creation, and Coder falls back to the main model's max_chat_history_tokens when no override is supplied.
evidence_units.source: git show 45b2ba8a1056bb27f197b01d08f3ea0d4d92b668:aider/args.py, lines 154-159; aider/main.py, lines 312-334; aider/coders/base_coder.py, lines 289-294

evidence_units.claim: Startup announcements include "Restored previous conversation history." whenever done_messages is nonempty.
No automated test file was changed by the first-parent diff, and no test at the pinned ref references split_chat_history_markdown, max_chat_history_tokens, or the new restoration path.

candidate_atomics.name: reconstruct-persisted-conversation
candidate_atomics.title: Reconstruct conversational messages from the persisted transcript
candidate_atomics.description: Convert the application's append-only Markdown transcript into model-facing user and assistant messages while excluding session metadata, tool output, commands, and empty prompts.

semantic_action.intent: Recover reusable conversational state from a human-readable persisted transcript without replaying operational noise as dialogue.
semantic_action.pre_state: A configured transcript contains interleaved session headings, user headings, assistant text, commands, and blockquoted operational output.
semantic_action.post_state: The transcript is represented as an ordered list of user and assistant message objects, with recognized non-conversational records excluded.
semantic_action.validation: Use a transcript containing each supported record type and verify that ordinary user headings and intervening assistant text are emitted in order while session headings, blockquotes, slash commands, and <blank> prompts are absent. The pinned implementation directly establishes these parsing rules, but the change supplies no automated test oracle.

candidate_atomics.name: restore-state-with-precedence
candidate_atomics.title: Restore persisted state only when no explicit state was supplied
candidate_atomics.description: At lifecycle initialization, preserve caller-provided completed messages; otherwise load and reconstruct the configured transcript and expose restoration to the user.

semantic_action.intent: Resume a prior conversation automatically without overwriting authoritative in-memory state supplied by the current caller.
semantic_action.pre_state: A new session has either explicit completed-message state, or an empty completed-message state plus an optional configured persisted transcript.
semantic_action.post_state: Explicit state remains authoritative; otherwise a nonempty persisted transcript becomes the session's completed-message state, and restored state is announced when present.
semantic_action.validation: Initialize once with explicit completed messages and once with an empty state plus a populated transcript; verify the first state is unchanged, the second contains reconstructed history, and the restoration announcement appears only for nonempty completed state. These branches are present in the pinned code but lack an automated regression test.

candidate_atomics.name: compact-restored-state-within-budgets
candidate_atomics.title: Compact restored history within session and model context budgets
candidate_atomics.description: Apply a configurable retained-history budget and bound each summarizer request to the summarizer model's input capacity before background compaction.

semantic_action.intent: Keep resumed state usable when persisted history is larger than either the desired conversation budget or the summarizer model's request context.
semantic_action.pre_state: Reconstructed completed messages may exceed the configured history budget, and the portion selected for summarization may exceed the summarizer model's maximum input context.
semantic_action.post_state: History within the configured budget is left intact; oversized history starts compaction, and the summarizer receives the newest portion of the selected head that fits its input limit with a reserve.
semantic_action.validation: Exercise histories below and above the configured budget and use a model with a known max_input_tokens value; verify no worker starts below the threshold, a worker starts above it, and the messages passed to summarization do not exceed max_input_tokens minus 512 according to the implementation's token counter. No such automated test was included in the change.

candidate_workflows.name: resume-persisted-conversation-safely
candidate_workflows.title: Resume a persisted conversation without displacing live state or overflowing context
candidate_workflows.description: A partial-order startup workflow that reconstructs a persisted transcript only when authoritative live state is absent, then conditionally compacts oversized restored state under both session and model context limits.

workflow_graph.goal: Start a session with usable prior conversational context while preserving explicit caller state and keeping restored history within configured and model-imposed token limits.
when_to_use: A stateful interactive application persists a transcript across process lifetimes and a new session should continue the prior conversation.
The persisted representation contains both conversational content and operational metadata that must not be replayed as model dialogue.
Restored state can be large enough to require compaction before continued use.
anti_goals: Do not replace explicitly supplied in-memory conversation state with disk contents.
Do not replay tool output, session metadata, commands, or blank prompts as conversational messages.
Do not summarize history that already fits the configured retained-history budget.
Do not send an unbounded restored transcript to the summarizer model.
not_applicable_when: The application has no persisted conversation artifact to resume.
The persisted artifact cannot be deterministically mapped to ordered conversational roles.
A caller requires explicit supplied state and persisted state to be merged rather than using explicit state as authoritative.
No reliable token counter or summarizer input limit is available for safe compaction.
inputs: history token budget or model default
workflow_graph.entry_state: Session initialization has begun; completed-message state is either explicitly supplied or empty, and a configured transcript may contain earlier conversation plus operational records.
workflow_graph.exit_state: Explicit completed-message state has been preserved, or persisted conversational messages have been restored; any restored state exceeding its budget has entered bounded compaction, and nonempty restored state is visible through the startup announcement.

steps.condition: Run when completed-message state is empty and the configured transcript contains text.
steps.validation: Verify ordered user/assistant reconstruction and exclusion of recognized metadata, tool output, commands, and blank prompts.

steps.condition: Always enforce precedence; file loading and reconstruction are conditional on the absence of explicit completed-message state.
steps.validation: Verify explicit state is unchanged, while empty state with a populated transcript becomes restored state and produces the restoration announcement.

steps.condition: Evaluate every restored state; start compaction only when its token count exceeds the selected history budget.
steps.validation: Verify threshold behavior and confirm that any summarizer request is restricted to content fitting within the summarizer input limit minus its reserve.

validation_ladder: Unit-check transcript reconstruction with representative user, assistant, session-heading, blockquote, command, and blank-prompt records.
Lifecycle-check precedence using both explicit completed messages and an empty state backed by a populated transcript.
Boundary-check compaction immediately below and above the configured history-token threshold.
Capacity-check that a large selected head is trimmed to the summarizer model's input capacity minus the reserved tokens.
Integration-check that a restarted session reports restoration and can continue using the restored completed-message state.
stop_conditions: Stop restoration and retain explicit state when completed messages were supplied by the caller.
Stop file-based restoration when the configured transcript is absent, unreadable through the input adapter, or empty.
Stop promotion as a fully validated resolution until automated parser, precedence, and compaction tests exist.
Stop or repair if transcript reconstruction cannot preserve conversational ordering or if bounded summarization fails.
unresolved_or_deferred: The pinned change includes no automated tests for transcript parsing, state precedence, startup restoration, token override propagation, or bounded compaction.
The parser does not flush a final accumulated assistant segment at end-of-file, so preservation of a transcript ending directly in assistant content is unresolved.
The standalone aider/history.py entry point calls an undefined summarize_chat_history_markdown method at the pinned ref and therefore is not a usable validation path.

The changed compaction calculation reverses and truncates the sized head before later slicing it with split_index; the exact tail-token accounting should be covered by focused boundary tests before treating it as a proven invariant.

unresolved_questions: Was omission of the final assistant segment from split_chat_history_markdown intentional because a subsequent user/session heading is expected to flush it, or is it a restoration defect?
Was the undefined summarize_chat_history_markdown call in the standalone history entry point expected to be renamed to the new split operation plus summarize, or was that entry point obsolete?

No CI or PR status-check evidence is available in the issue bundle, and the implementation commit adds no automated regression tests, so runtime validation beyond direct code inspection remains unavailable.
